nodes.title: SETUP — read this first
widgets_values:
## SETUP — read this first

**1. Put the files where ComfyUI can see them**
```
ComfyUI/input/stairway_seq/       <- your source frame sequence (jpg/png)
ComfyUI/input/neuronWithBubbles_ref.jpeg   <- the style reference image
ComfyUI/output/styleTransfer/     <- created automatically
```

**2. Batch stepping — IMPORTANT**
`PrimitiveInt (increment)` -> `MathExpression a * 64` -> loader `skip_first_frames`.
Every time you hit **Queue** it renders the NEXT 64 frames.
- Set the int back to **0** before starting a new sequence.
- If you change `frame_load_cap`, change the `* 64` to match.

**3. What to tune first**
- `KSampler.denoise` 0.9 — lower = keeps more of the original photo
- `IPAdapterAdvanced.weight` 0.8 — how strongly the reference image drives the look
- ControlNet strengths 0.55 (depth) / 0.65 (lineart) — structure lock
- `CircularVAEDecode = x_only` — seamless left/right tiling for 4-wall projection

Full docs: see README.md / README.hu.md in the repo.
